purpose: Canonical schema for ingesting California and federal family-law cases with source-grounded provenance.

fields.name: official case name
authorities: statutes, rules, regulations, and cases actually relied upon
people: judges, counsel, parties, experts where appropriate

ingestion_rules: Preserve the full primary-source locator before extracting propositions.
Separate procedural facts from holdings and dicta.
Separate majority reasoning from concurrence and dissent.
Record pinpoint locators for extracted propositions whenever available.
Do not infer that a cited authority was adopted merely because it appears in a citation list.
Do not infer a relationship from name similarity or keyword overlap alone.
Keep generated summaries subordinate to the underlying decision.
Mark unresolved metadata instead of fabricating missing fields.
priority_queue: California Courts of Appeal family-law decisions
federal decisions materially affecting California family-law rights
